a.lede: Critical flaw in EDK2 allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.
a.title: Code-execution flaw in UEFI firmware affects most servers on planet Earth

b.lede: A new UEFI bootkit named BlackX, deployed in an espionage campaign in early 2026, exploited the old Baton Drop vulnerability to bypass Secure Boot and load a malicious driver designed to interfere with security solutions from Kaspersky and Avast. [...]
b.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit exploits Baton Drop flaw to bypass Secure Boot
